coupons_value_check.name: coupons_value_check
coupons_value_check.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_off" between 1 and 99 and "coupons"."amount_off" is null) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."amount_off" >= 1 and "coupons"."percent_off" is null and "coupons"."currency" in ('IDR', 'USD'))

coupons_window_check.name: coupons_window_check
coupons_window_check.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."starts_at" < "coupons"."ends_at"

invitation_members_live_grant_unique.name: invitation_members_live_grant_unique
invitation_members_live_grant_unique.where: "invitation_members"."user_id" is not null and "invitation_members"."revoked_at" is null

invitations_purge_due_idx.name: invitations_purge_due_idx
invitations_purge_due_idx.where: "invitations"."deleted_at" is not null and "invitations"."purged_at" is null

invitations_deletion_window_check.name: invitations_deletion_window_check
invitations_deletion_window_check.value: ("invitations"."deleted_at" is null) = ("invitations"."purge_after" is null) and ("invitations"."purge_after" is null or "invitations"."purge_after" >= "invitations"."deleted_at")

invitations_purged_check.name: invitations_purged_check
invitations_purged_check.value: "invitations"."purged_at" is null or "invitations"."deleted_at" is not null

workspace_members_live_grant_unique.name: workspace_members_live_grant_unique
workspace_members_live_grant_unique.where: "workspace_members"."user_id" is not null and "workspace_members"."revoked_at" is null
